propositions: caused_by links accept arbitrary targets with no validation that the target has a referencing commit, enabling misattribution and invalid metrics
the referencing commit scan exists only in close_precheck._referencing_commits and has conflated semantics (None for unreadable history vs empty list for scanned-none-found)
caused_by links must be refused at both CLI and library layers identically unless --force is supplied, with a single shared predicate to prevent drift between preview and write
a caused_by target is valid only if the resolved target itself (not its descendants) has at least one referencing commit in code history
a commit-less code repo (no readable git history) allows the link; refusal means the target provably has no commit, never unverifiability
the escape hatch --force=<reason> must be implemented once in a shared location and reused by claim and link, with reconciler passing force for peer-authored edges
